title: Pising In The Driving Seat with Steve Pising
description: Formula Five driver, Steve Pising, reveals what drives him, his racy views on the motor business, keeps us on track with his private life, and candidly shares his hopes for the future.
quote: Let me say this to you now, if only everyone was as honest as a camel, the world would be a much better place, in my opinion.
